Structured Chunking for Enterprise Search
Abstract. We study how the layout of business documents affects retrieval. Our pipeline keeps every character of a document addressable, so answers cite the exact page and box.
1 Introduction

Retrieval quality depends on how documents are split. Chunks that respect the structure of the source keep headings, lists and tables together, so a passage that answers a question is found as one unit instead of three fragments. Three properties matter for a knowledge base:
every chunk maps back to a page region;
unchanged paragraphs are never embedded twice;
deletes leave no trace in any index.
2 Method
2.1 Layout analysis

Retrieval quality depends on how documents are split. Chunks that respect the structure of the source keep headings, lists and tables together, so a passage that answers a question is found as one unit instead of three fragments.

Pages are read column by column. A paragraph that reaches the bottom of a column and continues at the top of the next one is joined again, so its sentence is not cut in half by the layout of the page and the reader of the chunk sees the whole statement that the author wrote, including the clause that ends after the column break and the final words that close the sentence on the following column
